summary: Added deskstats/timeparse.py and moved all date/time parsing and building into it; tests (plus new tests/test_timeparse.py) pass, and CLI output and a fuzz of the old vs new parsers match the original under several time zones. Kept as-is: chats round to the nearest second (NEAREST_EVEN) although the guide's table says TRUNCATE (changelog and current code say nearest); out-of-range numbers/dates that used to escape as OverflowError/OSError still do (timeparse raises ValueError chained from them, callers re-raise the original); naive/two-digit-year/24:00 quirks unchanged.
